sentences.en: Taxis stood in a rank in front of the station.
sentences.zh: 出租车排成一列停在车站前面。

sentences.en: I want to keep working my way up the ranks.
sentences.zh: 我想继续努力往上爬，晋升更高的职位。

sentences.en: Japan ranks among the economic powers of the world.
sentences.zh: 日本是世界经济强国之一。
